description: This header file defines constants, macros, and function prototypes for managing WAN traffic utilities in a COSA Data Model Library, including DSCP handling and mode validation.

methods.name: IsBridgeMode
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is bridge mode.

methods.name: GetEthWANIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the Ethernet WAN interface index.

methods.name: CheckForAllDscpValuePresence
methods.description: Checks if all DSCP values are present in a string.

methods.name: ResetIsUpdatedFlag
methods.description: Resets the 'updated' flag in a DSCP info structure.

methods.name: UpdateDscpCount
methods.description: Updates DSCP count based on enabled DSCP list.

methods.name: InsertClient
methods.description: Inserts a client into the DSCP tree.
